name: a4_delta
description:
OBJECTIVE
    Ablation 4 (Sec. 7.3, Table 5) - EFFECT OF SCALING.
      (i)  the MRV scale exponent delta in C_MRV = Fix_MRV + Var_MRV * A^delta (delta -> 1: linear costs,
           no economies of scale; delta -> 0: area-independent costs).  Paper grid 0 ... 1.0.
      (ii) population scaling (Sec. 7.5): number of farmers n = 5 ... 1000 at fixed farm-size
           distribution, to show how the cooperative gain per farmer, the certification cost per
           hectare and solo feasibility evolve with the size of the pool (grand coalition only; the
           per-coalition allocation analysis is restricted to n <= 16 and is not needed here).
